zh.title: Norse Atlantic申請破產並停飛
zh.summary: Norse Atlantic申請破產並停飛，航班復飛時間尚未說明。
body: 路透社報導，Norse Atlantic已申請破產。Aerospace Global News則稱，該航空公司已暫停所有航班，且尚未說明航班何時可能恢復。
該報導另指出，Pakistan International Airlines（PIA）先前在英國航線使用Norse Atlantic的波音787-9客機；兩家航空公司於10月簽署濕租協議，涵蓋兩架Dreamliner，以擴大英國與巴基斯坦之間的運能。
PIA表示，將自11月26日起以自有波音777營運所有英國航班。

en.title: Norse Atlantic files for bankruptcy and halts flights
en.summary: Norse Atlantic filed for bankruptcy and halted flights; the airline had not said when they might resume.
body: Reuters reported that Norse Atlantic had filed for bankruptcy. Aerospace Global News said the airline had suspended all flights and had not said when flights might resume.

The report also said Pakistan International Airlines (PIA) had been using Norse Atlantic’s Boeing 787-9s on its UK services. It said the airlines signed a wet-lease agreement in October for two Dreamliners to expand capacity between the UK and Pakistan.
PIA said it would operate all UK flights with its own Boeing 777s from 26 November.
